Customer_Address.table_description: The Customer_Address table stores the physical addresses of customers, along with their contact information. It serves as a central repository for customer location data, facilitating communication, shipping, and other business operations.

_id.description: A unique identifier for each address record, automatically generated by the database.

Customer_Address_ID.description: A unique identifier for each customer address, used for internal reference and record-keeping.

Customer_ID.description: The identifier of the customer to whom this address belongs, used to link addresses to customer records.

City.description: The city where the customer is located.

State.description: The state or province where the customer is located.

Country.description: The country where the customer is located.

ZIP_Code.description: The postal code or zip code of the customer's location.

Primary_Contact_Number.description: The primary phone number of the customer.

Secondary_Contact_Number.description: An alternative phone number of the customer.

Created_Date.description: The date and time when this address record was created.

Modified_Date.description: The date and time when this address record was last modified. Initially null, updated when changes are made.

Customer.table_description: The Customer table stores information about individual customers, including their personal details, contact information, and record management data.

_id.description: A unique identifier for each customer record, represented as an ObjectId.

Customer_ID.description: A unique integer identifier for each customer.

Middle_Name.description: The customer's middle name, which may be null if not provided.

DOB.description: The customer's date of birth, represented in ISO 8601 format.

Gender.description: The customer's gender, represented as a string.

Created_Date.description: The date and time when the customer record was created, represented in ISO 8601 format.

Modified_Date.description: The date and time when the customer record was last modified, represented in ISO 8601 format. May be null if the record has not been modified.

Customer_View_History.table_description: This table stores the history of products viewed by customers, including the customer ID, product ID, product price, and timestamps for when the view was created and last modified.

_id.description: A unique identifier for each record in the table, represented as an ObjectId.

Customer_View_History_ID.description: A unique identifier for each customer view history record.

Customer_ID.description: The ID of the customer who viewed the product.

Product_ID.description: The ID of the product that was viewed by the customer.

Product_Price.description: The price of the product when it was viewed by the customer.

Created_Date.description: The timestamp when the customer viewed the product.

Modified_Date.description: The timestamp when the customer view history record was last modified.

Customer_Wish_List_Item.table_description: The Customer_Wish_List_Item table stores information about the items that customers have added to their wish lists, including the product details and pricing.

_id.description: A unique identifier for the wish list item, represented as an ObjectId.

Customer_Wish_List_Item_ID.description: A unique identifier for the wish list item, represented as an integer.

Customer_Wish_List_ID.description: The identifier of the wish list that this item belongs to, represented as an integer.

Product_ID.description: The identifier of the product that this wish list item represents, represented as an integer.

Product_Price.description: The price of the product at the time it was added to the wish list, represented as a decimal value.

Created_Date.description: The date and time when the wish list item was created, represented as a datetime value.

Modified_Date.description: The date and time when the wish list item was last modified, represented as a datetime value or null if not modified.

Customer_Wish_List.table_description: The Customer_Wish_List table stores information about the wish lists created by customers, including the list name, customer ID, and creation date.

_id.description: A unique identifier for the wish list document in the database.

Customer_Wish_List_ID.description: A unique identifier for the wish list.

Wish_List_Name.description: The name given to the wish list by the customer.

Customer_ID.description: The identifier of the customer who created the wish list.

Created_Date.description: The date and time when the wish list was created.

Modified_Date.description: The date and time when the wish list was last modified.

shipments.table_description: This table stores information about shipments, including their status, associated order, and relevant dates, providing a record of all shipments made by the business.

shipment_id.description: A unique identifier for each shipment.

shipment_status.description: The current status of the shipment, such as 'Delivered', 'In Transit', etc.

order_id.description: The identifier of the order that this shipment belongs to, referencing the Order table.

delivery_date.description: The date and time when the shipment was delivered to the customer.

created_date.description: The date and time when the shipment record was created in the system.

modified_date.description: The date and time when the shipment record was last modified, or null if it has not been modified since creation.

invoices.table_description: The invoices table stores information about invoices generated for orders, including the invoice date, amount, and payment details. Its purpose is to track and manage invoices for business transactions.

invoice_id.description: A unique identifier for the invoice.

payment_id.description: The identifier of the payment associated with this invoice.

order_id.description: The identifier of the order for which this invoice was generated.

invoice_date.description: The date when the invoice was generated.

amount.description: The total amount of the invoice.

created_date.description: The date and time when the invoice record was created.

modified_date.description: The date and time when the invoice record was last modified.

payments.table_description: The payments table stores information about each payment made, including the payment method, status, and timestamps for creation and modification. It serves as a record of all transactions and is linked to the orders table through the order_id foreign key.

payment_id.description: A unique identifier for each payment record.

order_id.description: The identifier of the order associated with this payment, referencing the order_id in the Order table.

payment_method.description: The method used to make the payment, such as credit card, debit card, or bank transfer.

payment_status.description: The current status of the payment, indicating whether it is completed, pending, or failed.

created_date.description: The timestamp when the payment record was created.

modified_date.description: The timestamp when the payment record was last modified. If no modifications have been made, this field remains null.

order_items.table_description: The order_items table stores information about the items within each order, including the product, quantity, and price. It serves as a bridge between the orders and products tables, facilitating the management of order details.

order_items_id.description: A unique identifier for each order item.

order_id.description: The identifier of the order that this item belongs to.

product_id.description: The identifier of the product being ordered.

quantity.description: The number of units of the product being ordered.

price.description: The price of the product at the time of the order.

created_date.description: The timestamp when the order item was created.

modified_date.description: The timestamp when the order item was last modified. If no modifications have been made, this field remains null.

Order.table_description: The Order table stores information about customer orders, including the order date, amount, and associated customer and address details.

order_id.description: A unique identifier for each order.

customer_id.description: The identifier of the customer who made the order.

customer_address_id.description: The identifier of the address associated with the customer's order.

order_date.description: The date the order was made.

order_amount.description: The total amount of the order.

created_date.description: The date the order record was created in the system.

modified_date.description: The date the order record was last modified in the system.

Locality.table_description: The Locality table stores geographic location information, including area, city, state, country, and zip code, with a unique identifier for each location.

Location_ID.description: A unique identifier for each location.

Area.description: The area or neighborhood of the location.

ZipCode.description: The zip code of the location.

Created_Date.description: The date and time when the location was created.

Modified_Date.description: The date and time when the location was last modified.

Product.table_description: This table stores information about various products, including their names, prices, descriptions, and categories. It serves as a central repository for product data, enabling efficient management and retrieval of product information.

Product_ID.description: A unique identifier for each product, used to distinguish one product from another.

Product_Name.description: The name of the product, which can be used for display and identification purposes.

Product_Price.description: The price of the product, represented as a decimal value with two places.

Product_Description.description: A detailed description of the product, including its features and benefits.
Product_Description.example_value: High-quality wireless bluetooth headphones with excellent features and durability. Perfect for both professional and personal use.

Product_Category_ID.description: The identifier of the product category to which the product belongs, used to establish relationships between products and categories.

Created_Date.description: The date and time when the product record was created, used for tracking and auditing purposes.

Modified_Date.description: The date and time when the product record was last modified, used to track changes and updates.

Product_Category.table_description: This table stores information about different product categories, including their names, target demographics, and creation/modification dates.

Product_Category_ID.description: A unique identifier for each product category.

Product_Category_Name.description: The name of the product category.

Target_Gender.description: The target gender for the product category.

Target_Age_Group_From.description: The lower bound of the target age group for the product category.

Target_Age_Group_To.description: The upper bound of the target age group for the product category.

Created_Date.description: The date and time when the product category was created.

Modified_Date.description: The date and time when the product category was last modified.

Product_Features.table_description: The Product_Features table stores information about the features of various products, such as color, size, and weight. It serves as a bridge between products and their respective features, allowing for efficient management and retrieval of product details.

Product_Feature_ID.description: A unique identifier for each product feature.

Product_ID.description: The identifier of the product to which the feature belongs.

Product_Feature_Name.description: The name of the product feature, such as color or size.

Product_Feature_Value.description: The value of the product feature, such as black or free size.

Created_Date.description: The date and time when the product feature was created.

Modified_Date.description: The date and time when the product feature was last modified.

Product_Image.table_description: This table stores images associated with products, along with their creation and modification dates, facilitating product image management.

Product_Image_ID.description: A unique identifier for each product image.

Product_ID.description: The identifier of the product to which the image belongs, referencing the Product table.

Product_Image.description: The binary data representing the product image.

Created_Date.description: The date and time when the product image record was created.

Modified_Date.description: The date and time when the product image record was last modified.

Store.table_description: The Store table stores information about retail stores, including their location, name, address, and owner details. It serves as a central repository for managing store data and is used to track store creation and modification history.

Store_ID.description: A unique identifier for each store, used as the primary key.

Location_ID.description: The location of the store, referencing the Location_ID in the Locality table.

Store_Address.description: The physical address of the store.

Store_Owner_Name.description: The name of the store owner.

Store_Owner_Phone.description: The phone number of the store owner.

Store_Owner_Email.description: The email address of the store owner.

Created_Date.description: The date and time when the store record was created.

Modified_Date.description: The date and time when the store record was last modified.

Store_Products.table_description: This table stores information about the products available in different stores, including the quantity of stock and the dates when the records were created or modified.

Store_Products_ID.description: A unique identifier for each store-product combination.

Store_ID.description: The identifier of the store where the product is available.

Stock_Quantity.description: The current quantity of the product in stock at the store.

Created_Date.description: The date and time when the store-product record was created.

Modified_Date.description: The date and time when the store-product record was last modified.
